questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Preconfigured templates: a service availability commitment that can include an uptime guarantee.
Management of the cloud: capabilities used to manage cloud resources, such as autoscaling, templates, health monitoring, and alerts.
Management in the cloud: the methods used to interact with cloud resources, such as a web portal, CLI, APIs, and PowerShell.
Management of the cloud: observing resource health and responding to failures.
Management in the cloud: a text-based method that supports repeatable and automated cloud management.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Management of the cloud — capabilities used to manage cloud resources, such as autoscaling, templates, health monitoring, and alerts; and Management in the cloud — the methods used to interact with cloud resources, such as a web portal, CLI, APIs, and PowerShell.
